attchmntText: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has submitted pre-issue advertisements for its Rights Issue to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India. The advertisements were published on November 09, 2026, in Financial Express English all editions, Jansatta Hindi all editions, and Financial Express Gujarati Ahmedabad Edition. The filing was signed by Bhumi Mistry, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Completion of dispatch of issue materials'.
voiceSummary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited confirms the completion of dispatching issue materials for the rights issue of 78,677,509 fully paid-up equity shares. The shares have a face value of Rs. 1 each and are issued at a cash price of Rs. 1.50 per share, which includes a premium of Rs. 0.50 per equity share. The Letter of Offer, Entitlement Letter, and Application Form were dispatched to eligible equity shareholders as on the record date of Wednesday, November 04, 2026. The dispatch process was successfully completed on November 06, 2026. This filing serves as a follow-up to previous communications dated June 30, 2026, and October 29, 2026. The company has informed the BSE and NSE listing departments of this completion. Bhumi Mistry, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on November 08, 2026.

voiceSummary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 05, 2026. Radhe Developers India Limited approved standalone audited financial results for the same period on November 06, 2026. Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited approved standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026. Dharti Proteins Limited appointed Bigshare Services Private Limited as its new Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, effective November 06, 2026, replacing System Support Services. Lesha Industries Limited approved un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026.

attchmntText: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights  is 04-Nov-2026.

Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 8, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 8 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 1.50 per share.
